turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got a free weekend and I want to start a new game.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fun. Are you in the mood for a big story you can sink into, or something quick you can pick up and put down?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait for me, I need to talk to Leo about something. Don't say a word until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you turn the music down a bit?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Leo, are you still playing that farming game?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Every night. I'm in my third year now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it worth getting? It looks kind of slow.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It is slow. That's the point. It's relaxing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can we play it together or is it single player?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: You can do co-op. Get it and I'll show you around my farm.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. You were picking a game for the weekend, big story or something quick?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Big story. I want to disappear for two days.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then go for a long open-world adventure. Stock up on snacks first.
